title: Beyond Error Mitigation: Using Boosting for Noisy Quantum Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.25752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum error mitigation (QEM) can recover information about ideal quantum computations from noisy circuit executions, but may require a large sampling overhead. Fundamental lower bounds show that recovering noiseless observables without problem-specific information can require superpolynomially many samples, with exponential overhead for broad classes of noisy circuits. However, problem-specific information can reduce the number of samples needed to obtain the required answer. We investigate this possibility in supervised quantum machine learning, where labeled examples provide information about the function to be learned. Binary classification provides such a setting, since correct prediction depends on the sign and margin of the classifier output rather than on accurate reconstruction of every noiseless expectation value. We develop a theoretical and empirical framework for comparing boosting of noisy parameterized quantum circuits

translated_title: 超越误差缓解：将提升方法应用于含噪声量子机器学习
translated_abstract: 量子误差缓解（QEM）可以从含噪声的电路执行中恢复关于理想量子计算的信息，但可能需要较大的采样开销。基本下界表明，在没有问题特定信息的情况下，恢复无噪声观测量可能需要超多项式数量的样本，对于广泛的含噪声电路类别甚至需要指数级的开销。然而，问题特定的信息可以减少获得所需答案所需的样本数量。我们在监督量子机器学习中研究了这种可能性，其中带标签的样本提供了关于待学习函数的信息。二分类任务提供了这样一种场景，因为正确的预测取决于分类器输出的符号和间隔，而不是对每个无噪声期望值的精确重建。我们开发了一个理论和实证框架，用于比较含噪声参数化量子电路的提升方法。
tldr: 该论文提出利用监督学习中带标签样本提供的问题特定信息，将Boosting提升方法应用于含噪声参数化量子电路，使二分类任务只需依赖分类器输出的符号和间隔而非精确重建无噪声期望值，从而超越传统量子误差缓解方法的巨大采样开销限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes applying boosting to noisy parameterized quantum circuits, leveraging problem-specific information from labeled examples in supervised learning, so that binary classification relies only on the sign and margin of classifier outputs rather than accurate reconstruction of every noiseless expectation value, moving beyond the large sampling overhead of traditional quantum error mitigation.
